_comment_purpose: Canonical GitHub branch protection spec. Applied per-branch by scripts/propagation/apply-branch-protection.sh. Null-valued fields are explicit to clear stale settings from previous ad-hoc configs.
_comment_required_status_checks: Contexts must match the 'job name' in each repo's GHA workflow (.github/workflows/*.yml) — typically 'quality-gates'. If a repo has no GHA check wired up yet, apply the template WITHOUT the context and add it after the workflow lands.
_comment_enforce_admins_false: enforce_admins=false is the admin-bypass escape hatch. IggyIkenna (org admin) can merge past a failing 'quality-gates' check by using --admin-override-coverage in quickmerge + admin-merge on GitHub. Non-admins see a hard block because they can't bypass branch protection.
_comment_1_approver: 1 approving review is the minimum to prevent direct-push. Raise to 2 when the team grows past 3 reviewers.
_comment_force_push_disabled: Force-pushes would let anyone rewrite history past the quality-gates check. Disabled for all protected branches.
